data.name: Luxor: Quest for the Afterlife
data.detailed_description:
LUXOR, o jogo de acção-puzzle com maior número de vendas, extravasa as fronteiras do Egipto para a Rota da Seda, na busca de riquezas muito para além da imaginação. Um dos rostos mais belos e conhecidos da História é também um dos seus grandes mistérios. Quando os artefactos sagrados da rainha Nefertiti são roubados, o seu espírito terreno convoca-o, com o objectivo de ajudar o espírito eterno da rainha a erguer-se. Com o canhão asas de falcão de Horus, poderá trilhar o seu próprio caminho numa grande viagem fora do Egipto.

Na sua aventura para descobrir e reunir as peças dos artefactos da rainha Nefertiti, terá oportunidade de explorar países exóticos como a Pérsia, a Síria, a Índia e outras regiões do Médio Oriente. Encontre cada um dos ladrões antes que as areias do destino mudem e derrote-os no novo Modo de batalha. Espera-o uma grande aventura em LUXOR: Quest for the Afterlife!

  • Escolha o percurso da sua demanda, numa viagem que tem como ponto de partida o Egipto e que o levará a 18 cidades de 6 regiões exóticas ao longo da Rota da Seda

  • Defronte adversários no novo Modo de batalha

  • Encontre os líderes inimigos para obter os artefactos mais valiosos

  • A rainha Nefertiti apela a si, o seu campeão, numa aventura em que está em jogo o seu destino no Além

  • 100 novos níveis no Modo aventura

  • Desbloqueie actualizações na loja do jogo, incluindo novos de conjuntos de bolas e canhão

  • Localize as peças dos artefactos de Nefertiti e reúna-os para melhorar as suas capacidades na campanha Aventura

  • Cenários ricos com suporte para ecrã panorâmico

reviews.review:
Memory nostalgia first killed Zuma for me , then it did the same for PVZ and now it will for this oldschool ''casual'' game. 

No need to explain what this game is it's a match 3  bubble with satisfying SFX , stage design , good help mechanic that gives you  the colors of  the balls that are close to the end goal and has a storyline to follow.

And somehow everything around these good bits is  ruined. The game is designed in a way where you are essentially traversing through different towns  which takes 3-5 stages each in order to capture thiefs (who also run through the city) while also collecting fragments of artifacts you also collect. Now why is this bad? Because  the stages between the towns you travel become longer and harder and mainly  - never change. You will make circles between the world map trying to collect all fragments and capture all thiefs while playing the same maps over and over because this game has no linear progression but instead just gets increasingly more frustrating to deal with as it gives you no new content and repeats the old one but more tedious.  At first you'll get 5 rows to destroy. then 6. Then 7, 8 , 9 ,10 , 11....... this is absurd. a stage that takes 11 entire collums to destroy is at least 6 minutes long.  and you have to beat 3-5 stages before you reach the next town which is just a name you sit on before going to the next town. You will see the same exact maps with more collums which take longer time to destroy and are faster making losses (especially if you are on the last 2-3 collums) so SO draining and frustrating.

The power ups are random so you can hope you get a good that destroys the orbs for you but even then this game is simply not casual and becomes annoyingly hard EVEN with the helper function and with the fact you have no lives meaning you can die over and over. And I thought Zuma was bad.  Zuma at least mitigated the insufferable game design for the last 1-2 stages. This game gradually becomes more insufferable to deal with. It has no new content to give it's like an endless mode that occasionally spews some story at you to nibble at and a few extra piss easy gamemodes which later on become more of a relief that you get them instead of the average stage that just takes so long to finish.

And there's some maps where the helper function actively plays against you as there would be 2 collums and  1 of them would be at the top of the map meaning you'll get orbs for that collumn  and god forbid there's one in-front of you  that has differen colours you'll simply sit there idling not knowing what to do as you lose and are forced to restart the stage. It's bad game design. It got boring to boring and frustratng to me not wanting to continue finish this game.  I am sad that I can no longer refund it. It's not worth it.
